name: Petalburg City
lines:
The higher my Pokémon’s Defense, the
more reckless I can be with my attacks.

I think you’ve taught me
a valuable lesson here.
Go on! The left door leads
to the Strength Room.
The right door opens to
the One-Hit KO Room.
Both of them have Trainers
who are offensively skilled.

How’s it going?
Have you tried using Surf yet?
